name: Glendale Galleria
summary: Contemporary shopping mall offers trendy retail shops & restaurants, plus the flagship Apple store.
description: Glendale Galleria is a large shopping center with a unique feel and a distinctive variety of stores, offering a diverse selection of high-end brands and unique retailers in Glendale, CA. The center provides an engaging shopping experience with expanded holiday hours and a wide range of stores and restaurants to explore.
demographics: The Glendale Galleria serves a diverse, urban trade area in the densely populated Los Angeles metropolitan region, attracting a mix of middle to upper-middle income households with significant representation from young professionals, families, and multi-generational shoppers. The center's Glendale location draws from Armenian-American, Hispanic, and Asian communities with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $120,000+ annually. Visitors typically seek a combination of value and quality, frequenting mainstream national retailers while also exploring unique specialty shops, with strong weekday lunch traffic from nearby office workers and robust weekend family shopping activity.
